name: Omoide Archive
source:
Main character's school gets closed. Only two childhood friends still play at this place. Meanwhile, a constantly missing student girl shows up and establishes Memories Department to preserve memories of this school. She wants to recreate all notable school events throughout the year.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的学校即将关闭，只有两名青梅竹马仍会在那里玩耍。此时，一名经常缺席的女学生现身，并成立“回忆部”，希望保存学校的记忆。她打算重现这一年里所有值得纪念的校园活动。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
